exercises.why: **стал** — стать (perfective): to stand (in a certain location or near someone or something); to begin; (in the negative) to be willing, to be going (used to express a determined negative attitude); to cost.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to stop, to cease, to quit
to find, to catch, to (manage to) meet (e.g. someone at home or at work)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: переста́ть — to stop, to cease, to quit; доста́ть — to reach, to touch; уста́ть — to get tired; заста́ть — to find, to catch, to (manage to) meet (e.g. someone at home or at work).
**перестал** — переста́ть (perfective): to stop, to cease, to quit. Wiktionary: пере- + стать.

exercises.why: **достала** — доста́ть (perfective): to reach, to touch; to take, to go fetch, to take out; to get, to procure, to obtain; especially about a product that is rare, or of which there is a shortage; (colloquial) to annoy someone badly. Wiktionary: до- + стать.
